entities.name: Lazotep Mines
entities.description: Mines outside Naktamun on Amonkhet, worked by anointed mummies, hidden source of lazotep used to create the Eternals.

entities.name: Lazotep
entities.description: A rare magical metallic-blue mineral, strong yet light, used for cartouches, tomb seals and the armor of the Eternals.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where the Lazotep Mines lie.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City near which the mines are scattered.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: An immortal legion of the worthy dead encased in lazotep armor, waiting for the God-Pharaoh's return.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The God-Pharaoh, whose return the Eternals await; planeswalker.

entities.name: Crypt of the Eternals
entities.description: Where embalming rites bond with lazotep.

entities.name: God Trials
entities.description: Trials whose completing initiates' corpses were carried on funerary barges.

entities.name: Gate to the Afterlife
entities.description: Sealed gate that funerary barges pass through to the necropolis.

events.summary: Anointed mummies mine lazotep beneath the desert outside Naktamun.
events.quote: these mines were worked tirelessly by anointed mummies

events.summary: Lazotep is secretly hidden aboard funerary barges and delivered to the necropolis to coat the bodies of the chosen dead, forging the Eternals.
events.quote: forging an army in waiting for the prophesied return of Nicol Bolas

relations.quote: Scattered across the arid outskirts of Naktamun

relations.note: an army in waiting for the God-Pharaoh
relations.quote: an eternal service to the God-Pharaoh
